ops.title: Narrow the records watch to the files that drive the List fingerprint
ops.description: Consumer.List watches WatchDirs=[home] (internal/mesh/consumer.go:69-80); synckit watches it recursively and its 30s recovery sweep enumerates ~/.cc-inbox/blobs (9,913 immutable files) every pass. The List fingerprint and export read only inbox.db records, sessions and claims. A direct inbox.db / inbox.db-wal watch is not equivalent: the backend recovers an absent or replaced WAL only on the 30s re-walk. Prefer a candidate that keeps eager create/replace handling (non-recursive parent plus a target filter, or an existing exclude mechanism), never a blind direct-file watch or a broad fallback. Evidence: /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/synckit-watch-scope-0541.json; recon run wf_993b1d0a-5f0.

ops.text: blobs, subscriptions, node and mesh bookkeeping no longer enumerated or dirtying records
inbox.db and inbox.db-wal create/replace still dirty records promptly
behavior on the deployed synckit build stated with version evidence
